title: Audit console: typed filtering, adaptive sampling, and role-aware export jobs
creator: Priya Raman
description: Build a robust audit console search and export flow that supports typed/structured filters, adaptive sampling for very large result sets, cursored pagination for UI browsing, and role-aware field redaction enforced by RBAC v2. The goal is to let engineers and auditors quickly find relevant events, persist queries as saved views, and produce CSV/JSON exports that are accurate, performant, and safe for cross-tenant or role-limited access. This ticket focuses on backend export job design, filter semantics, sampling strategy, and integration points with the console UI and RBAC enforcement layer.
acceptance_criteria: Search supports typed filters (actor:type, resource:id, kind:event, time:>=, outcome:in) with clear parsing errors surfaced in the UI
Cursor-based pagination for console browsing with stable cursors and graceful handling when results change between pages
Export jobs (CSV and JSON) can be started from a saved or ad-hoc query and either streamed to client for small result sets or executed as background jobs for large exports
Adaptive sampling mode available for queries estimated to return > 10M rows; sampling preserves distribution across actor/resource/action where possible and records sampling metadata in output header
RBAC v2 enforcement filters redacted fields server-side; exported files never contain fields the requesting role is forbidden to read
Export job audit events emitted (job.created, job.completed, job.failed, job.cancelled) with job metadata and cost estimate telemetry
UI shows estimated row count or a sampled preview before starting a large export and allows cancelation of background jobs
tasks: Design typed filter grammar and document parser behavior (edge cases and error messages)
API: add /audit/query endpoint supporting typed filters + cursor tokens + preview sampling flag
Worker: implement background export job runner with incremental checkpointing and resumable checkpoints
Storage: use export artifact bucket path templating and short-lived signed URLs for downloads
RBAC: integrate with RBAC v2 policy engine to compute field-level redaction map before export
Sampling: implement stratified sampling by actor/resource/action with deterministic seed option
Telemetry: add metrics for export duration, rows scanned, rows returned, bytes written, and estimated cost
UI: console changes for saved queries, preview pane, export modal with sampling options and role-aware warnings
E2E: add tests covering redaction, sampling correctness, cursor stability, and job cancellation
Docs: write runbook for operations and user-facing doc for saved queries and export limits
comments: 2026-02-18 Priya Raman: Initial ticket created after triage with Security and Product. Goal is to reduce friction for auditors while reducing accidental large exports and PII leaks. See design brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AUD/Audit+Export+UX+Brief

2026-02-22 Liam Archer: Spiked the typed filter parser. Chose a simple whitespace-delimited grammar with key:value tokens and quoted values. Will push prototype parser to git branch feature/ENG-70821-filter-parser. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6512

2026-02-26 Security (S. Martinez): Requested explicit field-level redaction mapping from RBAC; confirmed we should rely on policy engine rather than UI hide. Added security_review_required flag. Follow-up: provide list of sensitive field names for RBAC team.

2026-03-02 Backend (A. Novak): Implemented preview API returning up to 1k sampled rows and an estimate. Sample preview includes sampling metadata: sample_seed and sampling_ratio. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6548

2026-03-05 Product (E. Huang): UX review complete. UX requests that when a user with cross-org roles attempts a large export, show explicit consent and an audit banner indicating cross-tenant data is filtered. Also asked for a 'request export' flow for non-admins where export is queued for approval.

2026-03-09 Ops (K. O'Neill): Raised concern about cost of full table scans when customers run broad time-range queries. Proposed adding preflight cost estimate and a hard time-range cap for instant streaming. Ops proposed background-run-only for queries scanning > 48 hours by default.

2026-03-12 Liam Archer: Implemented background exporter with S3-compatible artifact storage and resumable checkpoints. Added job.created/job.completed events to kafka topic audit.jobs. Updated worker docs in repo. TODO: wire the download link TTL to customer's session policy (ENG-43210)
2026-03-14 QA (M. Patel): Began automated tests for RBAC redaction permutations. Found bug where redact list missed nested metadata.fields. Added test case and patch scheduled in next sprint.
links: Related ticket ENG-31258: live tail / snapshot export work
notes: We will default to 'preview+stream' for queries estimated <= 500k rows; anything above triggers background export workflow. Sampling will be optional but recommended for exploratory queries. Design to include a machine-readable header in exported CSV/JSON containing sampling metadata and policy_redaction_version.
release_notes: Add typed filter support, sampling preview, background export jobs with RBAC-aware redaction; admins can run large exports and non-admins can request exports for approval. Track export metrics in console insights.
